newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES STEADY, FORINT SEEN UP VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES STEADY, FORINT SEEN UP VS DLR.

text.p: 0648 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates were steady on Monday in abundant money supply and moderate activity, traders said.
* Overnight rates traded in a narrow range between 19.625 and 19.875 percent compared with Friday's close of 19.625 percent.
* The forint was seen opening firmer against the dollar and steady aganist the central bank's currency basket.
* The Hungarian unit was seen opening at around 198.20/25 against the dollar compared with Friday's close of 199.30.
